title: 第1223章 实力暴涨三个仙窍第1222章 双倍资源闭关提升
slug: 炼气家族我有一个造化空间
lines: 对于真仙初期而言，即便是李青元这样的绝世天骄，第一次服用三窍仙丹（三阶仙丹），药效也是无比雄浑。
毕竟三阶仙丹，通常情况是真仙后期才能服用。
李青元不急于破境，他们不是在飞升仙路时。
当初，第一御极强行炼化，只为尽快破境提升修为，故而只花了三十年时间，但仙窍并未完美打磨。
飞升仙路之上，生死存亡之际，容不得细嚼慢咽。
第一御极当初炼化一颗三窍仙丹，是以蛮力破境，速度快是快了，但根基留下了隐患。
如今第一御极正在打磨仙窍，让其更为圆润，让境界更为圆满。
打磨仙窍，比开辟仙窍更难。
开辟是破，打磨是筑，前者靠爆发，后者靠沉淀。
现在，李青元拥有天仙初期洞府，拥有安静宁和的修炼岁月，自然不急于求成，只需慢慢萃取丹药精华融入自身。
一转眼，时间过去一甲子。
六十年，只为一窍。
这不是慢，而是稳。
根基越稳，日后走得越远。
唰！
李青元陡然双眸一睁，眼中激射仙光，口吐惊雷："仙窍，凝！"
嗡！
他体内仙窍，108要穴仙窍之一，彻底凝练。
李青元的真仙之体，胸膛正中膻中穴仙光四溢，有建木法则之力外溢，小小窍穴已有海量仙灵之气储纳。
膻中穴，此窍一开，便如真仙小世界之中点燃了一盏明灯，照亮周身经脉，引动法则共鸣。
轰！
真仙小世界，第一颗仙窍星辰投影彻底凝实，仙光洒落真仙小世界，与小世界共鸣，垂落缕缕法则之力。
仙窍星辰垂落的法则之力在洗涤锤炼真仙小世界，只不过如今只有一颗星辰，这种洗涤极其细微。
但便是这极其细微的洗涤，已让李青元感受到了真仙小世界的蜕变。
天地更稳了，法则更清了，万物更实了。
李青元恍然："原来如此。"
"所谓的仙道领域——参悟法则、凝练仙窍、锻造仙体，原来都是为了锤炼仙道小世界。"
"体内小世界步步升级，真仙小世界、天仙中世界、金仙大世界。"
"一旦达到金仙境，体内世界化作一座大千世界，与封神大世界日月交融、万法共存，便可成为一座可以让无数生灵繁衍生息的完整世界。"
金仙之所以是仙道巨擘，不仅仅是因为战力。
而是因为金仙本身就是一方天地的造物主。
金仙大千世界之中，山川河流、日月星辰、万物生灵，一应俱全。
content_en:
For the early stage of a True Immortal, even a peerless genius like Li Qingyuan took the Sanqiao elixir (third-level elixir) for the first time, and the effect of the medicine was extremely powerful.
After all, third-level elixirs can usually only be taken in the late stages of true immortality.
Li Qingyuan is not in a hurry to break through the realm. They are not on the path to ascending to immortality.
At the beginning, the first Yuji was forcibly refined just to break through the realm as soon as possible and improve his cultivation. Therefore, it only took thirty years, but the Immortal Aperture was not perfectly polished.
On the path to immortality, when life and death are at stake, there is no room for chewing slowly.
When the First Yuji refined a three-aperture elixir, he used brute force to break through the realm. The speed was fast, but the foundation left hidden dangers.
Now the First Yuji is polishing the Immortal Aperture to make it more rounded and to make the realm more complete.
Polishing the immortal aperture is more difficult than opening the immortal aperture.
To develop is to break, and to polish is to build. The former relies on explosion, while the latter relies on precipitation.
Now, Li Qingyuan has the early stage of the Celestial Immortal Cave, and has a quiet and peaceful cultivation years. Naturally, he is not in a hurry for success, he only needs to slowly extract the essence of the elixir and integrate it into himself.
In the blink of an eye, time passed by.
Sixty years, just for one thing.
This is not slow, but steady.
The stronger the foundation, the further you can go in the future.
Uh-huh!
Li Qingyuan suddenly opened his eyes, his eyes blazing with fairy light, and he uttered thunder: "The fairy aperture, condense!"
Buzz!
The Immortal Aperture in his body, one of the 108 key points, is completely condensed.
In Li Qingyuan's true immortal body, the Tanzhong acupoint in the middle of his chest is filled with immortal light, and the power of the Jianmu Principle is overflowing. A large amount of immortal energy has been stored in the small orifice acupoint.
Tanzhong point, once this orifice is opened, it is like a bright lamp lit in the small world of a true fairy, illuminating the meridians of the whole body and stimulating the resonance of laws.
boom!
In the True Immortal Small World, the first Immortal Aperture star projection is completely solidified, and the fairy light shines on the True Immortal Small World, resonating with the small world, and falling with the power of the law.
The power of the laws of the falling stars in the Immortal Aperture is washing and tempering the small world of the True Immortal, but now there is only one star, and this washing is extremely subtle.
But even this extremely subtle cleansing made Li Qingyuan feel the transformation of the small world of the True Immortal.
The heaven and earth are more stable, the laws are clearer, and all things are more solid.
Li Qingyuan suddenly realized: "That's it."
"The so-called Immortal Realm—comprehending the laws, condensing the Immortal Aperture, and forging the Immortal Body, turns out to be all about tempering the small world of Immortal Dao."
"The small world inside the body is upgraded step by step, the small world of true immortals, the middle world of heavenly immortals, and the large world of golden immortals."
"Once you reach the Golden Immortal Realm, the world inside your body turns into a vast world. When the sun and moon blend with the Great World of Fengshen and all laws coexist, it will become a complete world that can allow countless creatures to thrive."
The reason why Jinxian is a giant of immortality is not only because of his combat power.
It's because Jinxian himself is the creator of the world.
In the vast world of Jinxian, mountains, rivers, sun, moon, stars, and all living things are all available.
